title: Short-term clinical outcomes of injectable platelet-rich fibrin as an adjunct to temporomandibular joint arthroscopy in patients with and without synovitis: a preliminary retrospective study
html: Temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders can cause persistent pain and functional limitations. Arthroscopy is used for refractory internal derangement, and injectable platelet-rich fibrin (i-PRF) has been proposed as an adjunct to improve outcomes. This preliminary retrospective cohort study was performed to evaluate clinical outcomes following TMJ arthroscopy with intra-articular i-PRF in adult patients with refractory internal derangement (Wilkes III–V) presenting at Rambam Health Care Center between January and October 2024.
